_what: The Penpot colour pairs that check:contrast asserts. A FROZEN SNAPSHOT of board colours — the gate reads this file, not Penpot.
_why: check:contrast reads tokens.css and the app stylesheet, so it structurally CANNOT see a Penpot board. That is how SCRUM-93 happened: the 0e3 role chip sat at 2.77:1 on a signed-off board (EN and ZH) while every gate stayed green — despite SCRUM-45 having cleared 132 AA failures in this same file. A signed-off board is not a checked board. This file is the bridge: the pairs are extracted from Penpot by penpot-sweeps/penpot-contrast-sweep.js and frozen here so CI can assert them without a Penpot connection.
_limits: ⚠️ A snapshot is not a sweep. This asserts the pairs BELOW and nothing else — a NEW pair added to a board is invisible here until the sweep is re-run. Re-run the sweep after any Penpot colour change. The sweep also composites fillOpacity; this file stores the resolved backdrop, so a tint is recorded as the colour it actually renders as, never as its raw hex. ⚠️ AND — found the hard way on 2026-10-11 — that sweep asserted ONLY chip pairs (`role chip (label)` / `chip · `) until SCRUM-11 added a second branch for the League boards. The league parts are named `row 1 · Chen Family (bg)`, `row 1 · rank`, `divider · promotion line`, `art · tier badge label` — matching NEITHER pattern — so the whole League board would have stayed invisible to the file's only refresh mechanism, on the same shape of hole that let SCRUM-93 ship.
_refresh: node penpot-sweeps/penpot-contrast-sweep.js (via the Penpot MCP plugin) — it prints the pairs it measured and fails if any is below its minimum. ⚠️ SCRUM-11 extended it with the League branch (part 1b) and the top-level-board fix (trap 7). The thirteen League pairs below were measured from the LIVE board at revn 365 by exactly those rules, but the EXTENDED SCRIPT had not been run end-to-end when they were frozen (the Penpot plugin tab kept suspending). Before the next board colour change: run the sweep and diff its `league` array against these pairs.
_source: Penpot file `JossPaperAR`, page "New-user tutorial · Core loop". The SCRUM-93 pairs were frozen from named version `S37b` at revn 287. The four SCRUM-94 pairs were measured live at revn 358 and saved as named version `S39 · SCRUM-94 — 0e8 disc + 7 Store Owned chip (revn 358)`; the six SCRUM-104 pairs (the confirm dialogs' cancel/no-thanks labels) were added at revn 364 under named version `S40 · SCRUM-104 — the 6 confirm dialogs grew 54px so Cancel sits ON the card`. All were saved via `penpot.currentFile.saveVersion()` — ⚠️ which EXISTS; the three-session-old claim that the plugin API had no version endpoint was itself the error (see follow-up-items.md), so do not repeat it. revn ticks on any change, including a live fault test that restores the same values. The thirteen SCRUM-11 pairs (the 6 / 6b League boards) were measured live at revn 365 — READ-ONLY, no board was touched, so there is no new named version and the file stayed at revn 365 throughout.
_rules: `text` must be `normal` (>=4.5:1) or `large` (>=3:1, i.e. >=24px, or >=18.66px bold). `min` is DERIVED from `text` by the gate and asserted equal to it — so the requirement cannot be quietly lowered to make a failing pair pass.
